duration.$description: How long a transition takes. Bigger elements and bigger moves get longer durations.

instant.$description: State changes with almost no travel: hover, press.

easing.$description: The shape of a transition over time.

enter.$description: Things arriving: start fast, settle gently.

exit.$description: Things leaving: start gently, accelerate away.

emphasized.$description: Hero moments that deserve extra attention.

spring.$description: Physics-based motion for things the user directly causes. Each spring is a perceived duration plus a bounce (0 = none, 1 = very bouncy).

stagger.$description: Delay between siblings entering one after another.

distance.$description: How far things travel when entering or leaving.

scale.$description: Starting scale for things that grow into place (1 = full size).
